product_metadata.title: G & S Metal Products Company OvenStuff Non-Stick Toaster Oven Pizza Pan Set of Two, 7.75'', Gray
features: SIZED FOR SINGLE SERVINGS: The OvenStuff Nonstick Toaster Oven Pizza Pan Set includes two 7.75-inch round personal-size pizza pans that fit in most standard toaster ovens.
NONSTICK FINISH: OvenStuff is made with a proprietary DuraGlide PLUS coating, so even the cheesiest of pizzas won't stick making cleanup quick and easy
QUALITY STEEL CONSTRUCTION: Made with quality steel construction, pan heats evenly ensuring pizza cooks with a uniform golden brown crust
description: The OvenStuff Nonstick Toaster Oven Pizza Pan Set comes with two 7.75-inch round personal-sized pizza pans. Each pan is coated with a proprietary DuraGlide PLUS nonstick coating so even the cheesiest of pizzas won't stick leaving cleanup simple and easy. Made from durable steel construction, pans heat evenly with no hot spots producing a golden baked crust every time. OvenStuff Nonstick Toaster Oven Pizza Pan Set is perfect for smaller ovens found in apartments, vacation rentals, and dorm rooms, but works great in conventional ovens too. These OvenStuff pans are made in the USA. Hand wash and towel dry thoroughly. External dimensions are 8-inch in diameter.

details.Specific Uses For Product: Baking pizzas and appetizers; Holding cakes and pies
